development_failures_and_repairs: A Windows timezone preflight failed because tzdata was not installed (chunk c7fc5c, exit 1). Freeze timestamps now use UTC and preserve the explicit America/Halifax study date; no model call was made by that failing check.

Read-only review identified manifest metadata tampering, closure on export/constructor failures, inference crossing a stage deadline, missing assistant role and setup schema mismatch. All were corrected before the development freeze and covered by offline tests. No evaluation run was replaced.
limitations: Engineering tests use scripted models and do not measure assistance quality.
SQLite guards local state only; source references and receipts do not establish semantic correctness.
The optional role session is not integrated into the live Lab and is not the native DeepAgents baseline.
No LoRA, ASR, user study, long-history compaction or external-service exactly-once behavior is tested.

publication.tracking: A separate deployment receipt records the final source SHA, Sites deployment and matching Pages build; artifact verification is not itself publication.

research_outcomes.note: Research success/failure labels are separate from passing engineering checks.

observed_remaining_defects: Twenty-five tracker proposals were rejected; four stages had no actor opportunity. No recovery repair was applied to the frozen study.
Private work conclusions are only shared when persisted by the model; one recorded run computes the right room but fails to hand it to chat.
All six seeded old reads were cancelled before arrival, so obsolete-result consumption is untested.
Early workshop gold over-specifies price relative to raw requests; secondary scores preserve uncertainty and sensitivity.
